# Airbag warning light reset procedure

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Turn the key, wait for a solid airbag light, and repeat this cycle four times until it goes off. [t298]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Turn the key to ON and wait for the airbag light to stay solid.
2. Immediately turn the key off within one second as soon as it starts blinking.
3. [Partial] Remove the key from the ignition.
4. [Partial] Repeat this cycle three more times in total (four cycles overall).
5. [Partial] On the fourth attempt, turn and hold the key until the light turns on solid then goes off completely.

_Procedure reported by [t298]._

## Parts

- Key [t298]

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Ensure the light blinks consistently before timing the second step. [t298]
- [Partial] Watch for the transition from solid to blinking immediately. [t298]
